newsitem.title: USA: Idaho voters reject property tax limiting measure.
newsitem.headline: Idaho voters reject property tax limiting measure.

text.p: Idaho voters soundly rejected a measure that would have limited property taxes, election officials said Wednesday.
Proposition One would have limited property taxes of all cities, counties and other taxing entities in the state to one percent of the assessed value of taxable property.
With 98 percent of the precincts reporting, 63 percent of voters opposed the measure, state election officials said.
Moody's Investors Service Inc had warned that the initiative could have substantially reduced the revenues of some local governments.
